metadata.question: Did the cropland around the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine apprear browner between June 3 and July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about cropland appearance around the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine between June 3 and July 19, 2023. They want to know if it appeared "browner" - which typically means less vegetation/health. For this analysis, I should: 1. Use Sentinel-2 data for high-resolution vegetation monitoring 2. Calculate NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) to measure vegetation health 3. Compare NDVI values - lower NDVI = browner appearance 4. Focus on the specific time period and location Strategy: - Define geometry around the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine - Use Sentinel-2 L2A data for the specified period (June 3-July 19, 2023) - Calculate NDVI and check if it's below a reasonable threshold for healthy vegetation - Handle potential data gaps with appropriate fallbacks I'll need to: - Check if collection has data, if not try fallback - Mask clouds to get valid pixels - Calculate mean NDVI over the region - Determine if vegetation appears "brown" (low NDVI) - Output appropriate answer tag ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry around North Crimean Canal in Ukraine const canalRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[34.0, 46.4], [34.5, 46.4], [34.5, 46.2], [34.0, 46.2], [34.0, 46.4]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for vegetation analysis const startDate = '2023-06-03'; const endDate = '2023-07-19'; let s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(canalRegion) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); // Check collection size const colSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 Images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No Sentinel-2 data found, trying Landsat 8..."); s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(canalRegion); const landsatSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 Images: ${landsatSize}`); if (landsatSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Cloud masking and NDVI calculation function maskClouds(image) { const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const qa = image.select('QA60'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const processedCol = s2Col.map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI); const medianImage = processedCol.median(); // 4. Check valid pixels const pixelCount = medianImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canalRegion, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NDVI const ndviStats = medianImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: canalRegion, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NDVI: ${ndviStats ? ndviStats.toFixed(3) : 'NaN'}`); // 6. Validation and final answer if (ndviStats === null || ndviStats === undefined || isNaN(ndviStats)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (ndviStats < 0.3) { // Threshold for "brown" vegetation console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
